title: The Lizardman and Éclair
text: “Oh? I recognize this area ahead, indeed.”
“You know this place, Motoyasu-kun?”

I kept as much distance as possible while whispering to Father. Incidentally, I made sure to stay far enough back that our idle chatter wouldn’t be overheard, while my ears and Rabbit Guy’s ears tracked where the half-breed lizardman had gone. Naturally, being a prison, the cells held all manner of demi-humans and beastmen locked away. Rabbit Guy quietly scanned the cells as we passed.
“Indeed. Éclair is being held just ahead.”
To reveal what I’d been hiding—the room where Éclair was imprisoned lay just up ahead.
“Éclair? Like, capturing a pastry…? Is that a person’s name?”
“Indeed. She’s been imprisoned for the crime of taking vigilante justice against soldiers who committed slave hunting, I say.”
“I did hear there was a noble who maintained friendly relations with demi-humans, so it wouldn’t be strange for someone like that to exist.”

“If memory serves, she’s the daughter of the lord who governed the region where Big Sister lived, and apparently inherited the position afterward, indeed. Though part of that territory later became Father’s domain.”
Apparently Big Sister’s village had, in some roundabout way, once belonged to Éclair’s parents’ territory.
“There was a girl talking with Shion back in Lute Village…”
Father seemed to have some recollection as he spoke, thinking back.
“Maybe this Éclair person went looking for wherever she was being held and snuck in?”
“What a troublesome girl. If she’d been discovered acting alone and gotten caught, what exactly was her plan?”
Rabbit Guy sighed a weary sigh, and Father gave a wry smile in response.
“Don’t scold her for it. She probably just couldn’t sit still and do nothing… Still, I suppose I’ll have to have a word with her about it later.”

Such merciful words from Father. Half-breed lizardman, you ought to be grateful, I say. And just as I said that, the half-breed lizardman, exactly as expected, stopped in front of Éclair’s cell, stared intently through the bars for a moment, and then seemed to speak to her.
“Éclair… Éclair-sama.”
“Hm? Who’s there…? …Shion, is it… hah… I must be seeing things. Someone who should have died in the wave, standing here of all places.”
Éclair’s voice sounded somewhat weary as she conversed with the half-breed lizardman.

“No, I’m not dead. Back then I was fighting where my father had assigned me, and once the sky cleared, I tried to head toward the lord and my father to rejoin them—but I was ambushed by soldiers who were supposed to be on our side. Before I lost consciousness, I heard them laughing, saying the lord and my father were dead… By the time I came to, my level had been reset and I’d been made into a slave.”
It seemed certain now that the half-breed lizardman and Éclair knew each other.
“If we just leave this be, won’t she end up breaking the cell open and helping him escape? That would be seriously bad if it happened, wouldn’t it?”
“…Well, given the circumstances, I suppose it’s about time to speak up.”
“Simply watching in silence is one option, but… in a situation like this, isn’t it customary for Iwatani-sama, as an understanding master, to show generous leniency?”
“Theo, I’m starting to think you’ve been reading a few too many stories lately… Well, given how this is playing out, I suppose I will.”
Rabbit Guy gazed at Father with eyes full of expectation. I decided to copy him. Misty-eyed and all, indeed.
“Never mind why Motoyasu-kun is looking at me with the same eyes as Theo right now…”
Father deliberately made his footsteps echo—clack, clack—lit a light, and called out.
“Shion.”
“!? You—kh.”
Looking as though he’d just been caught doing something he desperately didn’t want seen, the half-breed lizardman turned his face away from Father.
“Is the person beyond that cell an acquaintance of yours?”
“N-no…”
“You needn’t hide it. Given what kind of country this is, it wouldn’t be strange for something like that to happen.”
“I’m not… I’m not trying to help Éclair-sama escape.”
“Shion, I’m not scolding you for it.”
Father let out a deliberately theatrical sigh.
“I’d be rather hurt if you thought me the kind of master who’d make a fuss over something this small. Have you forgotten how many times I’ve generously overlooked you and Theo disobeying orders?”
“T-that’s…”
The half-breed lizardman trailed off, clearly unable to argue back.
“Is someone there?”
At that point Father shot a glance toward the half-breed lizardman, silently urging him to step aside, and peered into the cell.
“Hmm…”
Father turned his gaze back to the half-breed lizardman, his expression softening into something almost fond.
“Th-that person is Éclair-sama.”
“I see, Éclair, huh? Someone Shion’s sweet on?”
“…Hah… no.”
The half-breed lizardman answered Father’s quietly murmured question with a sigh that seemed a mix of exasperation and distaste.
“The closer truth is she’s like a sister to me. Our parents were close.”
“Heh… not even a little bit, huh?”

“No, and forgive me for saying so, but she’s far too straight-laced for anything like that. It’s nothing like the situation you’ve got going on around you. If you’re thinking of collecting her too, don’t.”
“Hey, that’s a little uncalled for, don’t you think? I’m the one who’s troubled by Motoyasu-kun being so forceful about it, you know?”
When Father glanced over, the half-breed lizardman noticed Rabbit Guy and me, who had quietly approached, and furrowed his brow.
“What are you all talking about?”
Éclair, from within the cell, seemed to have overheard. At that, Father gave a light cough.
“You’re an unfamiliar face. You don’t look like one of Melromarc’s soldiers… What are you?”
Éclair posed that question to Father.
“Shall I say I’m Shion’s master? Or would ‘Shield Hero’ suit better?”
“What!?”
Éclair’s voice rose, and she turned her face toward Father in response.

“As for what I might ask in return… well, I suppose I already know enough, having heard from Shion and the others. Éclair, imprisoned for the crime of dealing vigilante justice to soldiers who turned to slave hunting.”
“The Shield Hero!? What in the world is going on! What has happened while I’ve been locked away in here!”
Éclair glared at the half-breed lizardman as she demanded an answer.
“It seems that… after that incident, our nation of Melromarc performed the Hero Summoning, and all four of the Four Cardinal Heroes were successfully called forth.”
“Summoning… why would a summoned hero be here, of all places? What in the world is happening?”
“Éclair-sama, tonight a wave surged forth once more, and it was suppressed through the combined efforts of the heroes.”
“I—I see. No, that’s not what I meant. It’s good that the heroes are here, but…”
“Well, let’s just say there’s a lot going on right now, that’s probably the simplest way to put it. Even I’m not exactly in a great position, standing here with Shion.”
Father seemed to be explaining to Éclair that he’d come here in secret.

“You don’t look particularly convinced. Well… I imagine you two have plenty of catching up to do, but if we linger here too long, those people are bound to track us down, and that’ll turn into a hassle. What should we do about that… Ah, actually.”
Father grinned, a bold, mischievous smile spreading across his face. It seemed some idea had just struck him.
“Since it’s going to be a hassle either way, might as well stir things up a bit more on our end. It’d be interesting to see what Itsuki does once he learns about all this.”

“W-what are you planning to do!? I’m simply to wait here until the Queen returns. No… wait, if heroes have truly been summoned, I must report this at once. And more importantly, if you truly are the Shield Hero, then remaining in this country is extremely dangerous! You should hurry and head to the demi-human nation!”

“Well, that’s… there are a lot of complicated circumstances on my end too, you see. At first I thought about heading to Siltvelt, but then I figured—what kind of god of the demi-humans and beastmen would the Shield Hero be if he just meekly ran away and let this kind of unreasonable nonsense slide?”
Father smiled at the half-breed lizardman and Éclair with the look of someone who’d just thought up a delightful bit of mischief.

“Only a few days after being summoned, and already I’m slapped with false charges. Discriminated against just for being the Shield Hero. It’s been one thing after another, really. As for the details… well, you can hear the rest from Shion’s own mouth eventually. If this plan of mine fails, I suppose I’ll need to prepare for a hasty escape—though how I’d explain that to Raphtalia-chan and the others, I have no idea. Might be faster to just ask the Queen for help right away.”
The half-breed lizardman seemed to gulp audibly at that.
